messages:
Devon: Quick design review — new Metrics Panel (compact). Thoughts on default axis units and how to handle long tails / outliers? Screenshot uploaded.

Michael: My vote: default to percentile clipping at 99.5% for the visual, with a subtle affordance to "show full range". Keeps charts readable across noisy signals.

Anya: Prefer the term 'quantile clamp' in the UI? For units: use SI suffixes (ms, s) and switch automatically, but keep a manual 'force units' override for embedded dashboards. Accessibility note: aria-label should mention the clamp state, e.g. "chart showing 99.5 percentile clipped values — expand to view full range".

Samir: Clipping worries me if customers misinterpret. Suggest we visually indicate clipped data points with a faint top-hat glyph and tooltip saying: "value > 99.5th percentile — click to show full range". Microcopy: "Values above the 99.5th percentile are hidden to improve readability. Show full range."

Devon: Nice. UX idea: show a thin dashed line at the clipped boundary and a small count badge (e.g. "+3") next to the legend entry indicating how many points were clipped. Default ON for dashboard view, OFF for exported images/embeds.

Anya: Legend behavior: introduce 'condensed' vs 'expanded' mode. Condensed = color swatch + short metric name + clip-count badge. Expanded = full metric name, unit, and description. Also: legend items must be keyboard-focusable and expose aria-pressed for toggling series visibility.

Michael: Quick CSS/ARIA example for legend focus states:

```
.legend-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
}
.legend-item[aria-pressed="true"] { outline: 2px solid #2563EB; }
```

UI-Bot: UX Review checklist added: https://redwood.internal/ux/metrics-panel-review (I attached the checklist PDF)

Samir: Color contrast check: the current green swatch fails AA at small sizes. Propose swapping to #0f9d58 for the series green. Also ensure clipped glyph (dashed top-hat) meets 4.5:1 contrast against the background.

Anya: Smoothing policy — default OFF for precision dashboards. Offer three presets: none, rolling-mean (5m), median-filter (5m). Tooltip copy when smoothed: "Smoothing applied: rolling mean (5m) — disable in panel settings".

Devon: I'll update the Figma states and add the condensed legend variant + clip badge. Can folks review by EOD? Tagging @Michael @Anya for accessibility and copy.

Michael: On it. Tiny nit: for latencies, format ticks as `ms` when <1000ms, otherwise `s`. Avoid long words like 'milliseconds' on axis ticks — they're noisy.

Anya: Also add SR-only copy at the top of the chart container: "Chart shows [metric name] over time. For details, interact with the legend or use the 'expand' button." That helps keyboard/VO users understand controls.

Samir: :thumbsup: I'll run this against VoiceOver and report any focus issues tomorrow.

Devon: Thanks team — I'll push the updated components to the review branch and post Figma links here when ready."
